           x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --format-version 1
Scope: the selected root dependency graph, including normal dependencies,
       build dependencies, procedural macros, and their transitive dependencies.
       No development-only dependencies are selected by this manifest.

"runtime" means reachable from normal dependencies; this is a conservative
license inventory, not a claim that every selected function survives linking.
"build/proc-macro" means used by the build or a procedural macro. A package can
have both roles. Build-only notices are retained for audit completeness.

All packaged LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT/UNLICENSE documents,
license directories, and the default-font license texts are retained below.
Workspace licenses omitted from crate archives were obtained from the exact
upstream Git revision recorded in each crate's .cargo_vcs_info.json. Text is
retained without changing its licensing choices or copyright statements.
Source-document SHA-256 values identify original bytes; displayed text uses
UTF-8 and normalized line endings. Package license expressions are verbatim
Cargo metadata and may include alternatives or additional component licenses.

hexf-parse 0.2.1 declares CC0-1.0 but has no complete license document in either
its crate archive or recorded upstream revision. The standard CC0 legal text
is supplied from SPDX and identified separately; no missing upstream notice
has been fabricated. There are no packages without a supplied license text.

The bundled SQLite public-domain notice and Khronos/ANGLE source notices are
also retained. The Rust standard library and its bundled components are
covered separately by RUST-STANDARD-LIBRARY.html, copied from the toolchain's
unmodified COPYRIGHT-library.html. Microsoft runtime and externally downloaded
native engines have separate notices; they are outside this Cargo inventory.

See RUST-DEPENDENCIES.json for the machine-readable package/document inventory.
The v0.6.8 QR additions below are encoding_rs, num-derive, and quircs.
